sloka: स तेन राजा दुःखेन भृशमर्पितचेतनः ।अवगाढः सुदुष्पारम् शोकसागमब्रवीत् ॥२-५९-२८॥
transliteration: sa tena rājā duḥkhena bhṛśamarpitacetanaḥ ।avagāḍhaḥ suduṣpāram śokasāgamabravīt ॥2-59-28॥

translations.english: Where is that Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana who has wellshaped teeth and wields a mighty bow? If I can see him along with Sita I will survive.
